thread.title: All Dow stocks trading premarket are rising after jobs data

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All Dow stocks trading premarket are rising after jobs data
text: Shares of the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +0.38% components turned broadly higher in premarket trade Friday, after the release of better-than-expected jobs data , with the only one of 30 stocks not rising because it was still inactive. Dow futures YMH8, +0.61% surged 159 points, after trading slightly lower ahead of the data. Among the biggest gainers, shares of J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. JPM, +0.01% rallied 1.1%, Caterpillar Inc. CAT, +1.37% climbed 1.0%, Boeing Co. BA, +0.49% advanced 1.0% and Intel Corp. INTC, -1.13% rose 0.9%. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +1.09% which tacked on 0.6%. Travelers Companies Inc.'s stock TRV, +1.09% was still inactive.
